body:
Inspired by the pioneering work of Dr. Marcel Vogel, this 12-sided Clear Quartz Vogel is hand-cut with exact angles that reflect phi ratios, pyramid geometry, and lightwave coherence—transforming raw quartz into a precision instrument of energy transmission.

Designed to act as a scalar energy conduit, this Vogel crystal pulls energy in through its wider base (the “receiving” end) and projects it like a laser through the pointed tip (the “transmitting” end). Whether you’re using it for clearing, healing, activating, or manifesting—it delivers frequency exactly where it’s needed, without interference or distortion.

This is for the serious frequency worker, the advanced healer, the energetically curious, and the practitioner ready to take their practice to the next level.

  • 12-sided cut based on Marcel Vogel’s specifications for flow, coherence, and resonance

  • Made from high-grade Clear Quartz, the master amplifier

  • Acts as a scalar funnel, pulling in energy and transmitting intention with precision

  • Ideal for pairing with frequency generators for targeted bodywork and chakra healing

  • Each one is hand-selected and energetically tested for clarity and alignment
